properties.description: Lucius is an American five-piece indie-pop band formed in Brooklyn in 2011, anchored by lead vocalists Jess Wolfe and Holly Laessig. After meeting at Berklee College of Music, Wolfe and Laessig moved into a Ditmas Park Victorian house that became a creative hub where drummer Dan Molad and guitarists Peter Lalish and Andrew Burri joined to complete the lineup. The group gained attention for its twin-lead, tightly arranged harmonies, cinematic pop arrangements, and theatrical live shows. They self-recorded an early EP in the Ditmas Park house and released their full-length debut Wildewoman in 2013; later albums include Good Grief (2016) and Second Nature (2022). Lucius has toured extensively, appeared on major festivals and TV, and earned critical praise for songwriting, vocal production, and dynamic stagecraft.

The Wild Reeds are an American indie folk band formed in Los Angeles, California. They are known for their rich harmonies, introspective lyrics, and blending of indie folk, rock, and Americana influences. The band consists of Maggie Carney, Kinsey Lee, Nick Phakpiseth, and Nick Stewart. Their music often features acoustic instrumentation and explores themes of personal growth and relationships.

Rayland Baxter is an American singer-songwriter and musician recognized for his distinctive blend of alternative country, Americana, and folk rock. He has developed a reputation for heartfelt lyrics and a warm, engaging vocal style. properties.description: Lucius is an American five-piece indie-pop band formed in Brooklyn in 2011, anchored by lead vocalists Jess Wolfe and Holly Laessig. After meeting at Berklee College of Music, Wolfe and Laessig moved into a Ditmas Park Victorian house that became a creative hub where drummer Dan Molad and guitarists Peter Lalish and Andrew Burri joined to complete the lineup. The group gained attention for its twin-lead, tightly arranged harmonies, cinematic pop arrangements, and theatrical live shows. They self-recorded an early EP in the Ditmas Park house and released their full-length debut Wildewoman in 2013; later albums include Good Grief (2016) and Second Nature (2022). Lucius has toured extensively, appeared on major festivals and TV, and earned critical praise for songwriting, vocal production, and dynamic stagecraft.

The Wild Reeds are an American indie folk band formed in Los Angeles, California. They are known for their rich harmonies, introspective lyrics, and blending of indie folk, rock, and Americana influences. The band consists of Maggie Carney, Kinsey Lee, Nick Phakpiseth, and Nick Stewart. Their music often features acoustic instrumentation and explores themes of personal growth and relationships.

Rayland Baxter is an American singer-songwriter and musician recognized for his distinctive blend of alternative country, Americana, and folk rock. He has developed a reputation for heartfelt lyrics and a warm, engaging vocal style. His music often features acoustic instrumentation and storytelling that reflects personal and observational themes. Baxter has released several albums and is noted for his contributions to the contemporary Americana scene.

Kishi Bashi, born Kaoru Ishibashi, is an American musician and singer-songwriter renowned for his virtuosic violin playing and innovative use of looping technology to create lush, multi-layered compositions. His music blends elements of indie pop, baroque pop, and experimental sounds, often incorporating folk and electronic influences. Kishi Bashi's work is characterized by its intricate arrangements, emotive vocals, and a playful yet sophisticated approach to songwriting.

The Milk Carton Kids are an American indie folk duo consisting of Kenneth Pattengale and Joey Ryan. They are known for their intricate acoustic guitar playing and close vocal harmonies, often drawing comparisons to traditional folk and Americana music. Their music features introspective lyrics and a minimalist, acoustic sound that highlights their vocal interplay and storytelling.

Bahamas is the stage name of Afie Jurvanen, a Canadian musician and singer-songwriter known for his smooth blend of indie rock, folk rock, and alternative music. His music features acoustic instrumentation and introspective lyrics, often characterized by a laid-back, soulful vibe. Bahamas has released several albums and is recognized for his warm vocal style and intricate guitar work.

Matthew Logan Vasquez is an American singer-songwriter and musician, best known as the lead vocalist and guitarist of the indie rock band Delta Spirit. He is also involved in other musical projects such as Middle Brother and Glorietta. Vasquez's music blends elements of indie rock, folk, and Americana, characterized by heartfelt lyrics and dynamic performances.

Joseph is an American indie folk band formed by three sisters, Natalie, Meegan, and Natasha Closner. They are known for their rich harmonies, introspective lyrics, and blending of folk, indie, and pop elements. Their music often features acoustic instrumentation and emotive vocal performances, creating a warm and intimate sound. The band gained recognition with their album 'Native Dreamer Kin' and has toured extensively, building a dedicated fanbase.

Jamestown Revival is an American folk rock duo formed by childhood friends Zach Chance and Jonathan Clay. Their music blends elements of folk, Americana, and indie folk with rich harmonies and storytelling lyrics. They are known for their authentic roots rock sound and have built a dedicated fanbase through heartfelt songwriting and engaging live performances.

Shakey Graves, born Alejandro Rose-Garcia, is an American singer-songwriter and musician recognized for his unique one-man band performances. His music blends elements of folk, blues, and Americana, often featuring raw, heartfelt lyrics and a distinctive sound created by looping and playing multiple instruments simultaneously. He gained prominence with his album 'And the War Came' and is known for his energetic live shows and storytelling through music.

Hinge is a prominent dating application that distinguishes itself by prioritizing meaningful, long-term connections over casual hookups. By employing a unique profile structure centered around personal prompts and specific interactions, it encourages users to showcase their authentic selves. The platform is owned by Match Group and serves a global user base looking to navigate the dating world with greater intention. Its central philosophy revolves around the goal of being a tool that users eventually delete upon finding a successful partner.
properties.short_description: Hinge is a dating app designed to help people find meaningful relationships and get off dating apps by showcasing personality through text, photos, and video.

properties.description: Ship is a innovative dating application that reimagines the traditional dating experience by incorporating social validation and collective decision-making. Co-founded by the media brand Betches, the platform allows users to browse profiles and make suggestions not only for themselves but also for their friends. This community-focused approach aims to reduce the anxiety of digital dating by making it a shared and interactive social activity. The brand positions itself as a modern tool for those who value input from their social circle while navigating their romantic lives.
properties.short_description: Ship is a dating app powered by friends, co-founded by Betches, facilitating finding dates for oneself or friends.

properties.description: Splendid Spoon is a plant-based meal subscription service designed to eliminate the friction of meal planning for busy individuals. Founded to provide nutrient-dense, ready-to-eat soups, bowls, and smoothies, the brand focuses on convenience without sacrificing health outcomes. Its business model relies on a subscription-based delivery system that integrates seamlessly into the daily routines of health-conscious consumers. By prioritizing whole-food ingredients and sustainable practices, the company has positioned itself as a convenient wellness partner for urban professionals and working parents.
properties.short_description: Splendid Spoon is a plant-based meal subscription service offering ready-to-eat smoothies, soups, grain bowls, and detox programs for healthy eating.

properties.description: The Giving Keys is a social enterprise that produces hand-stamped jewelry featuring inspirational words, intended for wearers to eventually pass on to others in need. Founded in 2008, the brand leverages the concept of the pay-it-forward movement to foster human connection and support employment resources for individuals transitioning out of homelessness. Their product range focuses on affordable, sentimental items like necklaces, bracelets, and keychains that serve as daily, tangible reminders of personal growth. By combining unique, message-driven design with a commitment to social mission, the brand has cultivated a deeply loyal community focused on kindness and intentional living.
properties.short_description: The Giving Keys is a pay-it-forward jewelry brand that creates hand-stamped key necklaces with inspirational words, supporting a kindness movement.

properties.description: Rothy's is a San Francisco-based footwear and accessories brand that transformed the industry by utilizing 3D-knitting technology to create products from recycled plastic bottles. Known for their signature machine-washable flats, the company focuses on circular design to reduce waste in the fashion lifecycle. They cater to conscious consumers seeking long-lasting, versatile pieces that do not sacrifice comfort for style. With a strong commitment to sustainable manufacturing, the brand has successfully integrated eco-friendly practices into the mainstream retail market.
properties.short_description: Rothy's is a sustainable fashion brand known for washable shoes and bags made from recycled materials, including plastic bottles.

properties.description: Buy Me Brunch is a San Francisco-based brand that combines high-quality, ultra-soft fabric with humorous, minimalist graphic designs. Positioned in the casual graphic t-shirt market, it emphasizes a blend of wit and everyday comfort. Its designs prioritize sharp, clever messaging, making it a cult favorite for those who value personality in their casual wardrobe.
properties.short_description: Buy Me Brunch is a San Francisco-based brand specializing in ultra-soft, humorous, and minimalist graphic t-shirts and apparel.

properties.description: An innovative fashion company that revolutionized access to luxury style through its subscription-based rental model. By allowing members to rotate designer clothing and accessories for a flat monthly fee, it promotes a circular economy while helping consumers maintain a versatile and modern wardrobe. The service caters to a wide range of needs, from professional office attire to stunning event-ready gowns, effectively democratizing high-end fashion. Rooted in convenience and environmental awareness, it provides a flexible alternative to traditional ownership for style-conscious individuals.
properties.short_description: Rent the Runway is a designer clothing subscription service offering rental and purchase of high-end fashion items with flexible plans and free delivery.

properties.description: Lord Jones is a pioneer in the premium cannabis space, dedicated to creating high-quality, CBD-infused products that prioritize efficacy and aesthetics. Targeting discerning consumers, Lord Jones bridges the gap between wellness and luxury lifestyle. It remains a hallmark of the premium botanical market through its commitment to quality and thoughtful product development.
properties.short_description: Lord Jones is a premium cannabis brand known for high-quality CBD-infused products including body lotions, tinctures, and live resin vapes.

properties.description: Tuft & Needle is a pioneering direct-to-consumer sleep wellness brand that transformed the mattress buying experience through transparency and high-quality, foam-based products. With offerings ranging from mattresses to bedding and sleep technology, the brand caters to modern consumers who value comfort, convenience, and a straightforward shopping experience. properties.description: Hello, I am Andrea Savage (I’m Sorry, VEEP, Stepbrothers) and I have always dreaded the idea of being a “grown up.” I’ll be honest, it just sounded so f—king lame. But now I find myself a relatively together lady who is technically a grown person; I pay bills, I use an alarm clock, I’ve kept another human alive for a decade, but I also still like to giggle about anuses and tell dirty jokes. I like to say “I’m nuanced.” And I know I am not alone. So let’s take back the night!  This is the comedy podcast that every week is going to introduce another weird, hilarious, unique “grown up” celebrity guest to prove that even though you are technically an “adult”, you don’t have to be a total loser. Subscribe now and join the #buttholerevolution.

The headlines and weird news are lighthearted, unexpected and always fun. Like the time the delivery robot ran through a crime scene or the lady who took in a stray cat only to find out it was a mountain lion. Or the time Kurt and Scotty drove a butt across the country.

Check your local listings because this feel-good comedy podcast often goes on the road for live shows and may be in a city near you. Fun fact: We also hear the banana boys are a favorite amongst listeners while at the dentist, getting surgery and even giving birth!

limitations: Qloo results describe aggregate cultural affinities of audiences. They say nothing about any individual attendee's identity, preferences or behaviour.
An affinity score is a relative signal, not a probability that tonight's crowd will like or buy something, and not a causal claim.
Scores from separate Qloo calls are not comparable; each ranking only orders the options it was given.
Coverage is uneven: local acts, small vendors and niche comedians can have thin or no Qloo signal. Those are labelled, never invented.
Demographic charts are aggregate distributions from Qloo, used only for tone and pricing. They are never used to admit, exclude or target people.
